metadata.identity: N Corp. E.G.O::Fell Bullet Yi Sang
metadata.time_convention: Zero-based native decoded frame; seconds=frame/24; intervals end-exclusive. Input brief says 30 fps, but ffprobe counted 1035 frames at 24/1. No invented 30 fps frames.
metadata.method: Whole-video 6 fps overview, all native frames 300–836 viewed on 23 sheets, enlarged S1 contact sheet. Kit supplied locally; old notes consulted only after frame inspection.
metadata.measurement_limits: Body-height distances are screen-space estimates, not world measurements. Hex colors are visual palette approximations. Skill names are inferred: no skill-name/coin UI. Contact means first visible impact evidence; hidden contact is explicitly qualified.

name: See Through Defenses

weapon.parts: Long straight narrow barrel, rectangular receiver/fore-end, angular shoulder stock and dark grip; metallic parallel rails/highlights. No sword blade or bayonet can be established.
weapon.holding: Rifle carried into a low forward lunge; exact hand placement and striking part hidden by red trails at contact. No visible separate sword.

effects.description: Broad broken crescent/ribbon curling over shoulder and down right side
effects.layering: bright red or pale-gold core over red glow; dark maroon/black torn accents and translucent smoke; foreground effects obscure sprites
effects.motion_and_fade: Fast swing, splits into flakes and dims

effects.description: Long red horizontal speed smear and pointed red impact wedges, sparse gold needles
effects.layering: bright red or pale-gold core over red glow; dark maroon/black torn accents and translucent smoke; foreground effects obscure sprites
effects.motion_and_fade: Sweeps right; sparks start f330, persists through f333

effects.description: Ground-level red crescent, black/red flecks and target blood-like spray
effects.layering: bright red or pale-gold core over red glow; dark maroon/black torn accents and translucent smoke; foreground effects obscure sprites
effects.motion_and_fade: Crescent contracts and fades; target recoils

props.description: Red ribbon and fragments are effects, not detached solid blades.

caster_motion.description: Low rapid rightward dash, roughly 3–5 body heights; pan prevents exact displacement
Low crouched follow-through left of recoiling target; no visible second attack; cut resets positions

hits.contact: First gold impact sparks during close-range rush; rifle/body strike plausible, exact contact surface obscured
hits.uncertainty: Impact onset f330 (13.750); target visibly shares contact frame f333 (13.875). Exact geometry hidden; not a second hit.

beats.description: Single impact, gold sparks and red wedges; close-up holds 3 frames
Camera pulls out; floor crescent and flakes decay

camera.description: Side medium full-body caster shot, target offscreen right; preceding push began f307
Extreme low floor close-up, rapid pan right across column
Tight caster head/contact crop, target partially offscreen; 3-frame impact hold
Locked wide recovery; reset cut f359

mapping_evidence: One close-range physical impact; consistent with supplied one-coin Blunt S1. Red crescent is not evidence of a bladed weapon.
